create_ParlAIDictionary_from_file: create a ParlAIDictionary instance by loading a tab-separated dictionary file from disk
convert_txt2vec: convert a text string into a list of token index integers using the dictionary
convert_vec2txt: convert a list of token index integers back into a readable text string
convert_to_reddit_style: convert a ParlAIDictionary into a reddit-style dictionary with words, iwords, and wordcounts keys
create_from_reddit_style: create a ParlAIDictionary instance from an existing reddit-style dictionary structure
